clips.text: Sir, no, sir!
...Yes, sir!
All right men, you heard him! Code Red, repeat: We are at Code Red! Recon Plan Charlie, execute! Let's move, move, move, move, move!
Mission accomplished! Well done, men! Pack it up, we're going home.
Okay, we're on the last present now. / Last present!
It's a big one... It's a... It's a board game! Repeat: Battleship!
Look out for the downdraft!
You are drifting off course!
Do not freak out, soldier!
Relax and remember to breathe.
Keep your eye on that phone.
Drop and give me twenty!
Is that the best you can do?
What were you thinking?!
That is not how it's done.
You have got to be kidding me!
Let's try again.
Soldiers don't pout. Do it again!
Pick yourself up, soldier, and try it again!
You make me sick! Start over!
Write home, soldier, and tell 'em you're pathetic!
Good work, soldier!
All right! Mission accomplished!
You are an asset to toys everywhere!
What do you want, a medal?
That's how you do it!
I'm recommending you for a promotion. Great job!
Yes, sir! You heard him, men: Move, move, move!
Psst! Sir! We have a situation, sir!
Sir! I believe we can help.
My men are deployed throughout the room but tied up at the moment.
If you can free 'em, they'll get that phone down safely, guaranteed!
Men, where are ya? Sound off! Sound off! Roll call!
(The men sound off.)
That's all of them. Good luck.
Steady... Steady... Careful now. Looking good, soldier. Amazing work!
Lotso and his gang have reprogrammed Buzz...
...and incarcerated Rex, Slinky, Hamm, and Jessie in high-security zones!
If you want to free 'em, watch out for the spotlights and patrolling trucks!
If you're caught in the lights, an alarm will sound, and it's all over!
This rescue mission requires a covert, stealth approach.
Did you see the buttons that turn the lights off?
Remember, watch out for those spotlights!
Do not land on me! The telephone's the objective!
Remember, the telephone is the target!
All right, men: the landing zone is that telephone. Got it?!
All right soldiers, let's get to that telephone!
Land as close as you can to that telephone, men!
Soldier, what are you aiming at?! Do I look like a telephone to you? No? Well then hit the telephone!
Let's hit that target!
